placements.title: Intelligence you own versus intelligence you rent
placements.frame: How is the owned-versus-rented intelligence distinction drawn, and what does it cast as the durable asset worth keeping?
placements.why: All three segments perform one thematic subject: the individually-owned-intelligence thesis. src-1 and src-2 assert the owned/rented distinction through paired maxims (substrate-as-commodity, perspective-as-asset), and src-3 names and self-positions that distinction as a thesis for extraction navigation. This passes the narrative grain test — it names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (the strategic value of owned intelligence), not a one-time fact. No existing leaf or strata holds this theme.
